main_measure.name: mean forward 24-bar log return when forecast > 0 minus window mean over all bars, pooled

statistic.name: t of the mean of excess over non-overlapping blocks

main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; excess < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: share of positive fwd 24-bar returns when forecast > 0 minus share over all bars

decided_by: The main measure and the supporting check disagree in sign, so the result is inconclusive.
reading: The measure's value is the pooled mean excess over all forecast>0 bars (each demeaned by its own window's mean over all bars), its t is the ordinary one-sample t of that excess on greedy non-overlapping blocks that each start at the next forecast>0 bar after the previous block ends within a window, and the hit-rate shares are pooled across windows.
